highlights: 📱 PWA Download First & Clean Teacher Portal: Rebuilt Teacher Portal with a clean, mobile-first design focused entirely on quick student search, Complete Test Results History, and Full Attendance Biometric Records, along with 1-tap 'Install App' PWA banner on all web portals
🔗 1-Click Copy Buttons on All Portal Links: Added instant 1-tap Copy buttons directly beside each Web App URL input field (Parents, Staff, Teacher, Inquiry)
🪪 ID Card Terms & Conditions: Added all official Career Xone Terms & Conditions, rules, uniform policy, mobile ban, and lost card fees on the Back Side of the Student ID Card
📊 Dashboard Interactive & Responsive Cards: All stat cards are now fluidly responsive and clickable with hover animations and 1-tap navigation to Students, Attendance, Tests, and SMS Center
🔍 Share App Student Search: Added real-time student search bar in 'Share & Distribute Apps' under Separate (Single) mode to filter by Name, Roll No, Phone, or Batch

📥 OMR Download Location: 'Download OMRs' button now automatically saves scanned OMR images directly into the original source folder (/Green Bubbles) from where they were scanned instead of the default Downloads folder
👨‍🏫 Teacher Portal Web App: Student 360° Dossier, Test Series Analytics, Rank Trajectories & Daily In-Institute Hours Tracker (/#/teacher)
📋 Staff Inquiry Web App: Fast front-desk mobile inquiry entry with instant WhatsApp follow-up & status management (/#/inquiry)
⚡ Bidirectional Real-Time Cloud Sync: Automatic sync on internet connection & 512MB MongoDB cloud storage optimization
🗑️ SMS Center Bulk Delete: Row selection, Select All, Batch Delete, and 1-Click Delete All SMS
🕒 Attendance History Custom Date Range selection (From Date to To Date, Today, 7 Days, 1 Month, Heatmap) & All Students Excel (.xlsx) Download
📊 Inquiries Date Filters (Today, 7 Days, 1 Month, Custom Date Range) & One-Click Excel (.xlsx) Download report
✨ Added full Test Editing capabilities (Edit Name, Target Course/Class, OMR Layout, Subject Mappings & Marking rules)
📜 Root update note.txt live changelog viewer in sidebar
🛠️ Fixed Student Add & Edit crashes caused by MongoDB immutable _id payloads and Bcrypt typing
🎯 Calibrated OMR Scanner bubble coordinates for T1 (JEE 75) and T7 (OMR 50) with +2px offset
⚡ Resolved Electron input focus detachment when dismissing confirmation dialogues
📡 Synchronized biometric ADMS connection port with Express backend
☁️ Automatic Cloud Sync & Local MongoDB two-way restoration engine
📱 Parents App instant credential generation & bcrypt security
📊 OMR Engine multi-template calibration & processing stability
📝 Advanced Subject-to-Question mapping interface with dynamic question counts
📲 Automated WhatsApp & SMS instant notification system for attendance & admission
🔐 Local MongoDB data backup and one-click restore functionality
